Evidence of recurrent HGG that in the opinion of the treating team does not represent pseudoprogression and would require surgical resection
A Phase 0 Clinical Trial of Two Candidate Azoles (Ketoconazole and Posaconazole) for Patients With Recurrent High Grade Glioma
High grade gliomas (WHO grade III and IV)(HGG) are the most common malignant, and aggressive brain tumour in humans.

candidate_evidence.quote: From a preclinical standpoint, targeting hexokinase 2 (HK2), the first committed step of glucose metabolism, with azole class drugs has been shown to display favourable anti-tumour effects in both in vitro and in vivo HGG models.
[EXPERIMENTAL] Ketoconazole (KCZ) Single Dose Group: Single dose 400mg oral tablets 4-24 hours prior to surgery (interventions: Drug: Ketoconazole (KCZ))

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Evidence of recurrent HGG that in the opinion of the treating team does not represent pseudoprogression and would require surgical resection

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Intratumoral concentrations of KCZ or PCZ:
During the surgery, doctors will measure how much of the drug is present in the brain.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Assess Hexokinase 2 activity: enzyme activity measured using optical absorbance with a spectrophotometer
Downstream biological effects of drug on tumour tissue, including HK2 activity, will also be assessed.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Ketoconazole (KCZ) Repeated Dose Group: 400mg oral tablets twice a day (BID) for 2-5 days prior to surgery (interventions: Drug: Ketoconazole (KCZ))

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: targeting hexokinase 2 (HK2), the first committed step of glucose metabolism

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels; only 'WHO grade III and IV' high-grade glioma in the detailed description, so coded high_grade_glioma_unspecified (excluded) per C7/D27B. cns5_terminology coded historical because of WHO grade III/IV wording. Each azole is the sole agent in its own arms, hence experimental_monotherapy for both. Other tissue endpoints (Ki-67, TUNEL, VEGF/CD31 IHC) are downstream effect readouts, not listed as molecular biomarkers.
